en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi's not here.
Well, if he was, it'd be complete chaos...
What are you thinking of?
Huh?

You're worried about Kokichi, right?
We're all worried, too...

I searched everywhere for him, but I couldn't
find him at all.
Sure enough, he's a master of hide and seek.
He couldn't have...escaped by himself, right?

No. As long as Monokuma is here, I do not
think that is possible—

Like I said, just forget about him.
Anyway...

Listen up, everyone. I gotta tell you 
guys something.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito has an idea...?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a little awkward with Kaito
right now, but I should listen...
What's your idea, Kaito?
Hm? O-Oh, yeah...

<CLT=cltMIND>Lacking subtlety, Kaito averted his
eyes from me and looked around.

Looks like Monokuma isn't here.
Well, I wouldn't care even if he was.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito turned to us, his
expression suddenly serious.

Didn't I tell you guys yesterday?
I'm gonna get you guys outta here.
But to do that, I need your guys' help.
So please! Help me out here!
...What?

In order to help you guys, I need you 
all to work with me.
H-Hold on... What are you talking about?
Work with you? What do you mean?
Fight Monokuma with me.
Fight...Monokuma?
Now's our best chance...

Since the Monokubs are gone, the Exisals 
that were protecting him can't move...

Now's our chance to get together 
and kick Monokuma's ass!
<CLT=cltMIND>Fight Monokuma...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I see... That must be why Kaito
was looking for weapons.

But...Monokuma's probably got more spares. Won't
it be pointless, no matter how many we beat?

Then all we need to do is destroy them 
one by one till there aren't any left!

B-But...we don't know what Monokuma's 
got up his sleeve...

Even without the Exisals, this academy 
is still under his control...
Then...you're fine with the way things are now?

Do you guys really want to continue this 
killing game!? Are you okay with that!?

The only way to change things now...
is to fight.

If you want to put an end to this killing game,
then we gotta fight.
If we don't stand up now, then when!?

But we don't have anyone who can fight...
Like Gonta or Tenko—
Then I'll just have to fight on their behalf.
What...?

I know an assassin wouldn't say this, but I'm
sick of all this killing.
Maki...
Let's do it.
Huh? Keebo, you too?

My inner voice that guides me when I
feel lost spoke to me again...
It said, "Now is the time to stand and fight."

It may be a dangerous course of action, but
if it will prevent future victims...
Then I've decided that I will fight Monokuma!

I've been waiting for those words.
Very well...I'll lend you my power.
Huh? Were you really waiting for that?

I...don't want to lose any more friends.
It's even more painful than losing yourself...

That's why I'll fight!
I'm not afraid of Monokuma!

Okay then...me too. We can't let 
the killing game go on like this.
You're going to join as well, right, Shuichi?
...Y-Yeah. Right.
So we all agree... Then it's decided.

Let's do it! We're gonna beat Monokuma 
to a pulp!
Yes! Let's show him what we're made of!
I won't even need to use my magic!

No...I think that if you can use magic,
now's the time for it...

And when did you guys want to start?
I'm fine with starting right away...

Well, don't get ahead of yourself.
Because...this'll be the final battle.
We should make sure we're prepared.
Prepared for what...?

Prepared for battle, of course!
Well, I'll take care of that for you guys.

So you can make preparations, but you
can't clean up after yourself?

Well, since I was the one who brought this 
up, I gotta get things prepared at least...

So you guys just gotta prepare 
yourselves mentally.

The battle's gonna be tonight! Once it's
nighttime, let's meet up at the gym!

<CLT=cltMIND>After that, we ate breakfast and
prepared for our final battle.

<CLT=cltMIND>We separated for now and
returned to our rooms.

Though I do not know what crazy thing Kaito
will say, we should hear him out.

Kokichi, too...
But what is Kaito planning...?
Let's listen to him and find out.
Make sure you talk to Kaito.
I wonder where Kokichi went...

If he's off by himself...who knows
what he's up to...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a little awkward with Kaito
right now, but I should listen...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a little awkward with Kaito
right now, but I should listen...
